models.title: Model performance
models.note: Click a column header to sort; click again to flip the direction. Models with no successful sample (TPS or first chunk of 0) always sort last — they are never treated as the fastest.
models.note_joint: Each model keeps its providers together. Clicking a column sorts within each group; group order stays by request count, so switching dimension never changes which model leads.
